title: Why Arsenal asked NASA for help with ACL injuries

draft.hook_en: Another knee (ACL/meniscus) injury in the Premier League. Here's what the comeback looks like.
drills_to_film: Heel slides for knee bend, patella mobilisation
Short-arc leg extension with no load

all_phases.name: Phase 1 · Post-surgery basics (weeks 0–6)
drills: Heel slides for knee bend, patella mobilisation
Short-arc leg extension with no load

all_phases.name: Phase 2 · Strength & balance (months 2–5)
drills: Split squats and step-ups, slow and controlled
Single-leg balance on an unstable surface
Leg press building to body-weight equivalent

all_phases.name: Phase 3 · Plyometrics & return to play (months 6–9+)
drills: Double-leg → single-leg hops with soft landings
Cutting and pivot drills, planned then reactive

draft.content_angle: ACL rehab is a 9-month project: show what month 1, month 4 and month 8 look like, and why the landing mechanics matter more than the surgery.
draft.red_flags: Swelling that returns, the knee giving way or locking means stop and see the surgeon; return-to-play tests, not the calendar, decide readiness.
draft.caption_en:
Another knee (ACL/meniscus) injury in the Premier League. Here's what the comeback looks like.

Most knee (ACL/meniscus) rehab has 3 stages. This is the stage that gets rushed:
Phase 1 · Post-surgery basics (weeks 0–6)
1. Quad sets and straight-leg raises
2. Heel slides for knee bend, patella mobilisation
3. Short-arc leg extension with no load

⚠️ General training education, not medical advice. If you're injured, see a physio first.

💬 Comment SPEED for my 6-week speed program (for healthy players).
draft.caption_es:
Otra lesión de rodilla (ligamento cruzado / menisco) en Premier League. Así es la vuelta.

draft.hook_en: Another ankle injury in the Ligue 1. Here's what the comeback looks like.
drills_to_film: Standing calf raises, double → single leg

all_phases.name: Phase 1 · Protect & move (days 1–7)
drills: Weight-bearing as tolerated, seated calf raises

all_phases.name: Phase 2 · Strength & balance (weeks 2–4)
drills: Standing calf raises, double → single leg

draft.content_angle: Most ankle sprains come back because balance training gets skipped: show the 3 balance drills every footballer should do.
draft.red_flags: Inability to take 4 steps, bone tenderness or a syndesmosis (high ankle) sprain means imaging and a longer timeline.
draft.caption_en:
Another ankle injury in the Ligue 1. Here's what the comeback looks like.

Most ankle rehab has 3 stages. This is the stage that gets rushed:
Phase 2 · Strength & balance (weeks 2–4)
1. Band eversion/inversion, 3×15
2. Single-leg balance, eyes open → closed
3. Standing calf raises, double → single leg

⚠️ General training education, not medical advice. If you're injured, see a physio first.
